messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Solstice tenant (sol-789) on dedicated pool dp-3 in us-east-1 - tail latency spike on /v1/generate (text-gen). Paging @oncall for immediate triage.
Maya S.: ack, looking. seeing p99 spikes ~2.4s, p95 ~900ms. Queue depth up on worker-7.
Jason L.: logs show scheduler forming huge batches: `formed_batch tokens=12480 size=18` when max_batch_tokens was 8192. backend queue depth ~380.
Priya K.: sol-789 has bespoke batching enabled (custom_coalesce_v2). config excerpt: 
```
tenant: sol-789
scheduler:
  policy: custom_coalesce_v2
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  prefer_small_batches: false
  queue_shaper: disabled
```
Emily Z.: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) lower max_batch_tokens 2) enable queue_shaper/backpressure 3) temporary per-tenant rate-limit 4) fallback to smaller model variant while we stabilize.
Maya S.: agree. Reducing max_batch_tokens should cut tail. I'll push a canary change to one host first.
Maya S.: running canary command on dp-3/worker-7: 
```
# canary update for tenant sol-789
rbctl tenant update sol-789 --scheduler.max_batch_tokens=2048 --scheduler.prefer_small_batches=true --dry-run=false
```
deploy-bot: rolling update started for tenant sol-789 on dp-3 (canary: worker-7).
Jason L.: watching logs — previously: `formed_batch tokens=12480`, after canary: `formed_batch tokens=1986` on worker-7. initial p99 dropped from 2.4s -> 680ms on canary host.
Priya K.: enabling queue_shaper and per-tenant backpressure for sol-789. command: 
```
rbctl tenant update sol-789 --queue_shaper=enabled --backpressure.threshold=0.85
```
Emily Z.: also recommending temporary rate-limit for heavy routes: `rlimit /v1/generate sol-789 12rps`
Maya S.: applied rate-limit to generation route for sol-789 at 12rps. Notifying account.
Ron (AM): pinged Solstice ops: "We see elevated latency, apply short-term throttles and config change; will update." They responded: "ok, thanks — keep us posted."
Jason L.: metrics: overall pool queue depth falling from 380 -> 90 in 8 minutes. p95 ~330ms, p99 ~720ms across dp-3.
Priya K.: pushing change cluster-wide for sol-789 after canary success: 
```
rbctl tenant update sol-789 --scheduler.max_batch_tokens=2048 --scheduler.prefer_small_batches=true --queue_shaper=enabled --backpressure.threshold=0.85
# apply to dp-3 pool
rbctl pool assign dp-3 --tenant sol-789 --apply
```
Emily Z.: also toggled fallback model for requests over token_length > 1500 to `redwood-small` to reduce expensive large-token batches.
Maya S.: note: keep an eye on cost delta, fallback will increase request count but reduce per-request latency.
Jason L.: handoff note incoming — I'm heading out for meeting in 10. will leave watch on dashboards for 30m then hand to Alicia.
Maya S.: current status: mitigations in: lowered max_batch_tokens -> 2048, queue_shaper on, per-tenant backpressure at 85%, route rate-limit 12rps, fallback model rule in place. cluster p99 now 480ms, p95 300ms. async job queue cleared to ~40.
Alicia T.: ack, I'll take over at 16:20 UTC. checklist?
Maya S.: handoff checklist (for Alicia):
- confirm dp-3 p99 remains <700ms for next 45m
- keep rate-limit at 12rps unless Solstice requests raise it
- verify no large batches > max_batch_tokens in logs (`formed_batch tokens=...`)
- if tail rises again: scale dp-3 by +2 nodes and consider fast-fail fallback to model_small for >1k tokens
- capture snapshot: `metrics export --tenant sol-789 --range=30m > /tmp/solstice-spike.json`
Alicia T.: got it. will monitor and escalate if >10% error increase or p99 > 1s.
deploy-bot: canary successfully rolled to 6/6 workers for sol-789 on dp-3.
Jason L.: brief note — we saw one 502 spike correlated with the fallback toggle at 15:42; transient, recovered within 40s.
Maya S.: final note before handing off: flagged for postmortem, assign to eng-runtime + eng-sre + customer success for impact review. Ron, can you confirm customer comms cadence?
Ron (AM): will send an initial blameless heads-up to Solstice and propose a 1:1 postmortem tomorrow. They asked for timeline and root-cause summary once available.
Alicia T.: taking watch. leaving this thread pinned.
IncidentBot: Incident sol-789-high-tail-latency updated to status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Maya S.: thanks team. follow-up: we'll evaluate whether custom_coalesce_v2 parameters should be deprecated in favor of the new adaptive_coalesce policy.
Alicia T.: noted, will include that in the postmortem draft if tail patterns persist.
Ron (AM): closing customer loop later today, will include mitigation steps and ask about acceptable throughput vs latency tradeoffs.
